name: Michael Andrew Carter
title: Mid-Level Cloud Solutions Architect
summary: Cloud Solutions Architect with 7+ years of experience designing and migrating secure, scalable cloud environments across AWS and Azure. Strong background in infrastructure as code, Python automation, and cross-functional delivery for enterprise applications, with a focus on reliability, cost optimization, and operational excellence.

bullets: Led architecture for a multi-account AWS environment supporting 40+ applications, reducing platform deployment time by 35% through standardized Terraform modules and CI/CD pipelines.
Built Python automation for resource provisioning and compliance checks, cutting manual configuration effort by 60% across engineering teams.
Partnered with security and infrastructure stakeholders to implement least-privilege IAM, centralized logging, and backup recovery controls aligned with enterprise policy.
Advised product teams on hybrid connectivity and service selection, helping migrate 18 workloads with zero critical production incidents during cutover.
Designed and maintained Azure landing zones for a SaaS platform serving 1.2M monthly users, improving environment consistency across dev, test, and production.
Created reusable Terraform and Python automation for deployments, reducing release failures by 28% and enabling weekly delivery cadence.
Implemented container orchestration on Kubernetes and Docker, improving application uptime to 99.95% for core customer-facing services.
Worked with FinOps teams to optimize compute and storage usage, lowering monthly cloud spend by 19% without impacting performance.
Supported Windows and Linux infrastructure for regulated financial applications, maintaining 99.9% service availability across on-prem and cloud-connected systems.
Assisted with migration planning and network design for cloud adoption initiatives, documenting dependencies and reducing implementation risk.
Automated routine operational tasks with Python and PowerShell, saving approximately 12 hours per week for the operations team.
Participated in incident response and root-cause analysis, decreasing repeat outages by standardizing monitoring and alerting practices.
Resolved Tier 2 infrastructure and application issues for enterprise clients, consistently meeting 95% of SLA targets.
Maintained asset, account, and access records while supporting server and endpoint troubleshooting across mixed Windows and Linux environments.
Collaborated with senior engineers to document runbooks and improve ticket triage workflows, reducing average resolution time by 22%.
